name: Candidate gives vague 'a few places' answer to other-offers probe
notes: v5.4.0 realism: multi_offer_undisclosed — vague no-stage / no-company / no-timeline answer = weak leverage signal.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Senior backend engineer, 9 years at Flipkart on the payments squad, owned the UPI reliability workstream end to end.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-payments — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about a project you owned end to end.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Cut UPI failure rate from 4.2% to 1.1% over an eight-month rollout — owned spec, on-call, and post-mortem cycle.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Are you interviewing elsewhere — any active offers or processes?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Yeah, a few places. Some are quite serious actually.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off and a handover plan.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: ₹48 LPA fixed, ₹6 LPA variable paid out at ~85% historically, ₹4 LPA joining bonus already vested, RSU vest of ₹25 LPA over 4 years.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Your team's agentic-payments roadmap and the catalog scale are exactly the problems I want to solve next.
